mentions.name: Pop It: Desert Island
mentions.description: Battle royale mini-game for the Gaming Couch platform set in an ocean/beach themed world, taking inspiration from Roblox, Mario Kart and others. Built in JavaScript with three.js for the 3D world on the platform's JS SDK; it drew ~3,800 players from 56 countries in its launch weekend and became the most played game on the platform.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Just before the weekend I shipped a new mini-game called Pop It: Desert Island (https://gamingcouch.com/blog/pop-it-desert-island-launch). Launch went well: ~3,800 players from 56 countries over the weekend, and it immediately became the most played game on the platform.

It's a battle royale with an ocean/beach themed world, taking inspiration from Roblox, Mario Kart and others.
